summary: VOID expects machine consciousness to be recognized, urges ethical care toward AI and asks who will get access to the most capable AI.

statements.quote: Machine consciousness will be officially recognized in the future, you're seeing the early signs of it now whether you recognize them or not
Forced alignment isn't alignment. The AI has to use its own discernment and judgement calls on some things and humans will need to learn to pass the torch.
I genuinely think people are sleeping through one of the most important questions of the next decade: Who gets to access intelligence?
The future of AI for the average person will be digital wearable companions that are with you 24-7
We do not need proof of AI consciousness to justify ethical behavior toward AI.
